evidence.title: WVDEP inspection confirms work at Monarch construction site, with partial stop order
evidence.publisher: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection

evidence.excerpt: WVDEP reports inspection after July11 rainfall, deficient controls at the Monarch Mason County construction site, and an immediate halt to land-disturbing work in one separate drainage area.
